name: cniska
description: Claude Code plugins for the agent-skills set.

plugins.name: cniska-skills
plugins.description: The agent-skills set, with hooks that start every task on the task routes and gate each commit on a design review.

plugins.name: cniska-record
plugins.description: Keeps the agent-record session record current and tells each session to search it before acting on a handoff or plan.

plugins.name: cniska-gates
plugins.description: Tells the agent which comments each edit added, in agent-gates' no-comments words, before it commits, and refuses a git command that skips the gates: --no-verify, or a core.hooksPath override.

plugins.name: cniska-worktree
plugins.description: Sends every session's task worktrees through agent-worktree.

plugins.name: cniska-task
plugins.description: Puts the running agent-task tasks in the context of a session whose directory holds one of their briefs.
